gloss: kind and caring; as if family

definitions.gloss: kind and caring; sincere; as if one's own family
definitions.explanation: Treating someone else's problem with the warmth and seriousness one would show a member of one's own family. Mostly used of help, advice and care.

examples.japanese: {親身|しんみ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親身|しんみ}になって⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My teacher gave me advice as though my problem were his own.

examples.japanese: {入院中|にゅういんちゅう}、⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧さんたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{親身|しんみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{和|やわ}らいだ→和らぐ：07896_yawaragu⟧。
examples.english: While I was in hospital, the nurses cared for me so warmly that my anxiety eased.

notes:
From {親|しん} (close, intimate) + ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body, self); the original meaning is a close blood relative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親身|しんみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to take someone's problem to heart
- {親身|しんみ}になって⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to give heartfelt advice
- {親身|しんみ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: caring treatment (common in customer reviews)
- {親身|しんみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to look after someone devotedly

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with ⟦しんみり→しんみり：04833_shinmiri⟧ (quiet and sad; heart-to-heart), which sounds similar but means something different.
